title: Bounded complexes with finite-dimensional cohomology over a field
statement:
Let $F$ be a field and $D(F)$ the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian category of $F$-vector spaces, with cohomology spaces $H^i(K)$. Define

$$
 D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(F)\subset D(F)
$$

to be the full subcategory of the objects $K$ such that $H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i$ and every $H^i(K)$ is finite-dimensional over $F$. This is the blueprint's "bounded derived category of finite-dimensional $F$-vector spaces", realized inside $D(F)$; no comparison with the derived category of the abelian category of finite-dimensional spaces is made or used.
